title: P18.6 — Semantic-First Goal Understanding + FINAL closure: GUARDED run-level mode binding (missing/failed-pin evidence fails closed), item-bound approval resolution (unreviewed ambiguity stays blocked), strict full-lineage replan snapshot scope
description: P18.6 FINAL closure on base cabd25d (post-#155 main) - remediates three governance findings over the semantic-goal-understanding diff. F1: planner_run.semantic_mode bound durably at run creation - a GUARDED-stamped run whose interpretation evidence is missing/mismatched/unavailable/malformed fails closed at confirm (swallowed analysis or pin exception can never masquerade as gated interpretation); historical OFF/SHADOW/legacy runs keep evidence-driven compat. F2: owner approval resolves ONLY the ambiguity it reviewed - every material-driving UNRESOLVED item in the confirmed revision's pinned analysis must be covered by an approved statement (deterministic >=60% token-overlap); uncovered/new ambiguity stays blocked; AUTHORITY_CRITICAL always fails closed. F3: latestGoalIntentSnapshot requires strict business/objective/work_item/project lineage equality - unknown or missing scope never silently satisfies a more-specific request; generation-time scope re-verified before replay, mismatch forces fresh authorized analysis. Adversarial probes cover all three closures plus OFF/SHADOW/legacy compat. Baseline P18.6: versioned GoalIntentAnalysis via ONE bounded provider request (cached on goal x context x schema x model x scope; unavailable => typed evidence, never fabricated); provenance classes - interpretation is ADVISORY only (extractGoalContract/assertPlanCoverage/F10 ceilings/operatorGoalOf remain sole authority; no minting requirements/capabilities/budgets/permissions, never satisfies coverage); reconcileIntent classifies contradictions; HARMLESS|MATERIAL|AUTHORITY_CRITICAL policy; owner-approved amendments mint new canonical goal revisions (append-only, digest-bound); PAIR_SEMANTIC_MODE=off|shadow|guarded default off; both planner transports share the bounded advisory prompt seam; replan pins the interpretation snapshot; scope-tenanted cache/evidence; no secrets persisted; OFF is regression-identical to P18.5; no auto-merge.
